findings.text: follow-on: stamp_of records only the directory listings and the resolved plan file, so an edit to a sibling candidate's plan-slug or reckon-type metadata that changes which plan resolves is not detected and a stale figure is served, where the removed walk stamped every non-archived plan file's identity and did detect it.
follow-on: the recorded gate command carries the placeholder "<66-file gate: ...>" in place of the literal command list, so the gate behind the 736/1 result cannot be re-run from the record.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit f6d378cd8 against base 00e8e3f59; it adds _docs_scan_directories and rewrites _estimated_hours to cache through capabilities.cached_pick_input_stamped, plus the new test file and a one-line landing fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when requires identical (hours, source) across the enumerated node shapes, a walk-count test, an edit-stamp test, a live perf measure whose after-median is under 50 ms, and a negative control; tests/test_estimated_hours_reads_one_plan.py asserts the first three and the manifest records the perf figures and the red control.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is "A pick finds the node's plan without walking the whole docs tree"; reckon/crew/routing.py:3671 _estimated_hours now resolves via resources.resolve_resource and caches on the directory listings a resolve reads and the resolved plan file, with reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:502 as the production caller.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the head gate at 736 passed with one pre-existing failure against the base at 715 passed with two, judges by delta, and names the base/head/perf/control logs on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's four declared paths; the diff's three paths (reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_estimated_hours_reads_one_plan.py and docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/estimated-hours-reads-one-plan.html) are all inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_estimated_hours_reads_one_plan.py:189 reddens when the walk is restored (negative-control.log) and :211 fails if the resolved file's stamp is not read, though no test covers a sibling candidate's metadata edit.
justifications.evidence: the gate result and the perf figures are recorded with their logs, but gate-head.log:3 and the manifest's tests field record the command as an unsubstituted "<gate-list>"/"<66-file gate>" placeholder, so the exact gate that produced the result cannot be re-run from the record.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:3641 _docs_scan_directories follows the module's private-helper docstring idiom and carries no plan or stage label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:3671 replaces the per-call docs.rglob("*.html") with a resolve cached on directory listings and the resolved plan file, and perf-base.log/perf-after.log record the live median falling 177.9 ms to 0.5 ms at an identical figure.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing capabilities.cached_pick_input_stamped and ledger._file_identity owners and mirrors routing.context_census; reckon/crew/routing.py:3661 re-states the INFRA_DIRS and evidence-fragment prune resources.identify_resource applies, for which no scan-directory owner exists.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff's three paths (reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_estimated_hours_reads_one_plan.py, docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/estimated-hours-reads-one-plan.html) are declared-path members and no other file is touched.
